universe.sampling: ten trending pages plus ten new-pool pages on Base

matching.matching_note: Nearest-neighbor fallback uses log token age plus half-weighted log liquidity distance when strict buckets contain fewer than the minimum sample.

calibration.score_definition: equal-weight mean of four same-stage activity percentiles
calibration.warning: This is a current pool snapshot, not a prediction or investment score.

limits: The universe contains trending and new Base pools, not only manually verified Meme tokens.
Nearest-neighbor matching improves comparability but does not create historical outcomes.
Percentiles describe this collection-time snapshot and can change with the market.
Market activity is separate from social authenticity, safety and expected return.
